chapter: Pay, the Fletcher Henderson circle and later life
title: Fletcher Henderson musicians' high salaries
summary: Benny Morton's story shows Fletcher Henderson's band paid exceptionally well.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well, the only thing -- a few years ago, four or five years ago George Weill had got some college gigs he got some colleagues' tapes in New Jersey, and he wanted -- I think there was four or five things or something, you know. They were like concerts. And he wanted many more Benny Morton. And he said, do you know where Benny Morton (unintelligible) is? And I said yes, and I called Benny, and I said, do you (unintelligible) want this thing. And it was $300.00.

So Benny said, well, I wouldn't mind. I wouldn't mind it. This was, you know, a few years ago, four years ago, five maybe. But he said, no, I used to earn more than that with Fletcher Henderson. And I said, well -- he said, no, he said, I think I ought to -- I ought not to sort of sell myself that cheap. Well, I've heard that before (unintelligible), Fletcher made an awful lot of money (unintelligible).
But I mean that would be a fan- tastic amount of money --
